Good work!Over de functieThe Operator A is responsible for ensuring that the assigned production line operates efficiently, producing products that meet both quality and quantity standards. Your key Responsibilities:

- Our warehouses operate 24/7, so the work schedule includes weekend shifts as well as morning, afternoon, and night shifts.

With a 33% market share in the Netherlands and partnerships with names like Jumbo and Superunie, we set the standard for freshness and innovation. Join us and be part of a team where every day is about excellence, growth, and making a real impact in the food industry!

Samenvatting Are you the Delivery Hero who makes sure orders reach customers on time? Then start now as a Delivery Driver at the largest supermarket chain in the Netherlands in Bleiswijk. Your tasks include:

As a driver's assistant, you will work in various towns in the area surrounding the Municipality of Alphen a/d Rijn. You can also work in other departments. This part-time position is ideal if you are looking for flexible work or a side job, and best of all: no experience is necessary!

In this role, you will be sorting glass beer bottles, refilling machines with lid rolls, and assisting operators with their work on a daily basis. You will also help keep the workplace clean.

Bavaria's production runs both during the day and at night, so work is carried out from Monday to Friday in three different shifts:

- Early shift: 6:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.
- Late shift: 2:00 p.m. – 10:00 p.m.
- Night shift: 10:00 p.m. – 6:00 a.m.

We are looking for someone who is flexible, as you may be scheduled at different times. The position requires a minimum of 3 days per week, with flexibility in which days you work.

After the tour...

So, expect to spend about 4 hours on the tour and e-learning combined. During the e-learning, you will learn about company rules, problem solving, and professional knowledge, among other things.
